en.answer: No, it cannot. <<8392>>'s effect to Special Summon itself is considered an Equip Spell effect, not a monster effect.
en.question: If <<8392>> equipped to a monster is Special Summoned by its own effect, can the effect of <<15995>> be activated?
en.title: If <<8392>> equipped to a monster is Special Summoned by its own effect, can the effect of <<15995>> be activated?
